editorial.title: Who Is Deepak Dhar? The Small-Town UP Boy Who Studied Under Feynman — and Just Joined Physics' Most Exclusive Club
editorial.excerpt: The 74-year-old Indian theoretical physicist just won the 2026 Dirac Medal, becoming the first Indian-born recipient. His journey from Pratapgarh to Caltech to the pinnacle of world physics — and the sandpile that connects it all to AI.
editorial.image_caption: Deepak Dhar, INSA Distinguished Professor at ICTS-TIFR Bengaluru. The 74-year-old theoretical physicist won the 2026 ICTP Dirac Medal for his contributions to statistical mechanics.

sources.label: IIT Kanpur - Prof Deepak Dhar Interview

editorial.nri_angle: Deepak Dhar's journey from a small-town UP childhood to Caltech and back to India, winning honors that place him among Hawking and Witten, represents the deep scientific contributions of Indian-origin minds that often go uncelebrated compared to tech industry success stories.
editorial.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Army Soldier's Father Deported on July 4 Despite Military Service Promise
just_in.excerpt: A U.S. Army soldier who enlisted partly because the military promised to protect her immigrant parents saw her father deported on Independence Day, as congressional Democrats launch a probe into ICE's targeting of military families.
just_in.nri_angle: The erosion of military family immigration protections affects immigrant communities including Indian Americans who serve in the armed forces, raising questions about the reliability of service-based immigration commitments.

just_in.title: Trump Administration Moves to Eliminate 60-Day Grace Period for H-1B Workers
just_in.excerpt: The proposed change would strip laid-off H-1B visa holders of the 60-day window to find new employment or change status, leaving hundreds of thousands of Indian tech workers vulnerable to immediate deportation proceedings.
just_in.image_caption: The USCIS headquarters in Washington, D.C. The agency has begun issuing deportation notices to H-1B workers still within the 60-day grace period after job loss.
just_in.nri_angle: Indians account for roughly 72% of H-1B visa approvals, making this change a direct threat to hundreds of thousands of Indian tech professionals and their families in the United States.

just_in.title: Estrogen-Only Therapy May Not Raise Dementia Risk, Major Review Finds
just_in.excerpt: A WHO-commissioned meta-analysis of more than one million women found menopause hormone therapy neither increases nor decreases dementia risk, while a separate study suggests estrogen-only treatment may be safer than combined therapy.
just_in.nri_angle: General health journalism relevant to all women; no forced diaspora framing.

news.nri_angle: Jainendra Jain becomes the first Indian-origin scientist to win the Wolf Prize in Physics, drawing a direct line from rural Rajasthan to the pinnacle of global physics recognition.

travel.title: Japan Orders Mass Evacuations as Typhoon Dolphin Cancels Over 500 Flights
travel.excerpt: The Category 1 storm is bearing down on southwestern Japan with 144 kph winds, forcing 260,000 to evacuate and shuttering Toyota factories. China's eastern coast braces for landfall within days.
travel.image_caption: Typhoon Dolphin approaching southwestern Japan on Friday. The Category 1 storm has forced the evacuation of nearly 260,000 residents across Kagoshima and Okinawa prefectures.
travel.nri_angle: Indian nationals and diaspora travellers in Japan or eastern China should monitor advisories as the storm disrupts flights, rail and ferry services during peak summer travel season.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Iberia to Chase the Solar Eclipse at 35,000 Feet in a Historic First
travel.excerpt: The Spanish airline will fly an Airbus A321XLR above the clouds on August 12 to observe Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century, livestreaming the event globally via Starlink.
travel.image_caption: An Iberia aircraft. The Spanish flag carrier is planning a special flight to chase the solar eclipse at 35,000 feet.
travel.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora in Europe, the eclipse offers a rare celestial spectacle visible from Spain, with Valencia, Zaragoza, and Barcelona all in the path of totality — an experience not seen from the Iberian Peninsula since 1912.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Army Soldier's Father Deported on July 4 Despite Military Service Promise
carousel.excerpt: A U.S. Army soldier who enlisted partly because the military promised to protect her immigrant parents saw her father deported on Independence Day, as congressional Democrats launch a probe into ICE's targeting of military families.
carousel.nri_angle: The erosion of military family immigration protections affects immigrant communities including Indian Americans who serve in the armed forces, raising questions about the reliability of service-based immigration commitments.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Mumbai Biker Riddhi Thakkar Dies in Hit-and-Run During All-Women Group Ride
carousel.excerpt: The 24-year-old Mumbai woman was killed when a speeding truck rammed her motorcycle on NH-30 in Chhattisgarh's Bastar district while she was on a group ride with 22 other women bikers.
carousel.nri_angle: The growing women's biking movement in India resonates with Indian diaspora communities who follow developments in gender empowerment and road safety back home.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Karan Tacker on Why Outsiders in Bollywood Cannot Afford a Single Failure
carousel.excerpt: The Special Ops and Khakee star opens up about the persistent bias against TV actors in the film industry, the pushback he has faced on every project, and why the ecosystem needs to change.
carousel.nri_angle: Tacker's story about outsider struggles resonates with diaspora audiences familiar with Bollywood's nepotism debates and who follow OTT platforms like Netflix globally.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Ex-Pakistan Selector Blasts Young Cricketers for Being 'Focused on Money'
carousel.excerpt: A former PCB chief selector has slammed Pakistan's young cricketers for prioritizing earnings over developing their game, invoking India's late Bishan Singh Bedi as an example of selfless dedication to cricket.
carousel.nri_angle: The invocation of Indian cricket legend Bishan Singh Bedi as a model of dedication highlights the enduring cross-border significance of cricket in the South Asian diaspora.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Cognition Seeks $40 Billion Valuation Just Months After $1 Billion Raise
carousel.excerpt: The AI coding startup behind Devin is reportedly in talks with investors for a new funding round, powered by surging enterprise demand that could push its annualized revenue past $1 billion.
carousel.nri_angle: Cognition's founders are competitive programmers, and the company's AI coding tools are reshaping how software engineering teams work globally.

carousel.title: Tata Motors Reports Strong Q1 as Demand Holds Firm Despite Commodity Headwinds
carousel.excerpt: India's largest automaker posted standalone profit of ₹1,528 crore and a 19% revenue jump, while its commercial vehicle unit delivered an 83% profit surge aided by a one-time Tata Capital gain.
carousel.nri_angle: Tata Motors' earnings reflect broad strength in India's domestic economy, with implications for investors tracking one of the country's largest industrial conglomerates.
